sources.title: OAuth client could send credentials to an authorization server chosen by the MCP server
sources.excerpt: Summary In affected versions, the SDK's OAuth client let the MCP server decide which authorization server received the client's OAuth
sources.maintainer_guidance_summary: HTTP OAuth clients holding credentials can send them to an authorization server selected by an untrusted MCP server. Servers and stdio clients are excluded. Upgrade; bundled providers still need expectedIssuer, saved credentials need issuer or clearing, and custom providers must preserve issuer. Direct refreshAuthorization/exchangeAuthorization calls and skipIssuerMetadataValidation remain outside the fix.

sources.title: Server bearer authentication accepted tokens issued for another service
sources.excerpt: Summary In affected versions, the SDK's server-side bearer authentication had no way to check that a token was issued for
sources.maintainer_guidance_summary: HTTP bearer authentication may accept tokens for another audience when the verifier omits audience checks. Upgrading alone does not enable protection: set expectedResource and return AuthInfo.resource from verifyAccessToken; alternatively enforce aud in the verifier.

sources.title: Experimental tasks were not tied to the session that created them
sources.excerpt: Summary In affected versions, the experimental tasks feature (taskStore) did not check which session created a task. Clients sharing one
sources.maintainer_guidance_summary: Experimental taskStore tasks were not session-bound. Upgrade or remove taskStore or allocate one InMemoryTaskStore per session; 2.x packages excluded.

sources.title: Shared transport or server instances delivered one HTTP client's messages to another
sources.excerpt: Summary In affected versions, an MCP server reached over HTTP could deliver one client's responses and notifications to another client.
sources.maintainer_guidance_summary: Shared HTTP server/transport instances misroute client messages. Upgrade and create one server plus transport per request/session, or provide a server factory to createMcpHandler. stdio excluded.

sources.title: HTTP client transports and OAuth requests followed cross-origin redirects and re-sent custom headers and request bodies
sources.excerpt: Summary In affected versions, the SDK's HTTP client transports and OAuth requests followed redirects to any origin. If an MCP
sources.maintainer_guidance_summary: HTTP client/OAuth redirects may resend custom headers and request bodies across origins. Upgrade and configure final URLs; redirectPolicy follow restores exposure. Refuse redirects as a workaround. stdio excluded.

sources.title: One HTTP request within the default size limit could exhaust server memory during validation
sources.excerpt: Summary In affected versions, servers put no limit on how many array elements and object keys they validated in one
sources.maintainer_guidance_summary: HTTP validation can exhaust memory within the body size limit. Upgrading alone is insufficient: set maxToolInputElements and reduce maxRequestBodySize or the application body-parser limit. stdio excluded.

sources.title: HTTP server transports and handlers did not limit request body size or JSON-RPC batch length
sources.excerpt: Summary In affected versions, MCP servers reachable over HTTP put no limit on the size of a POST body or
sources.maintainer_guidance_summary: HTTP bodies/batches were unbounded. Upgrade every installed affected adapter; patched defaults cap body size at 4 MiB and batches at 100 messages. Reverse-proxy body limits are a workaround; stdio excluded.

sources.title: Sharing server/transport instances can leak cross-client response data
sources.excerpt: Summary Cross-client data leak via two distinct issues: (1) reusing a single StreamableHTTPServerTransport across multiple client requests, and (2) reusing
sources.maintainer_guidance_summary: Sharing HTTP transport/server instances can leak cross-client messages. Upgrade and isolate one server and transport per request/session; guards convert reuse into errors.

sources.maintainer_guidance_summary: Exploded resource URI template patterns allow excessive regex backtracking. Upgrade to 1.25.2 or avoid exploded array patterns and validate incoming URIs.
